authorityBoundary: Sai owns VN/Ink story semantics, visual manifest semantics, story command interpretation, and plugin ABI behavior. Eve owns only plugin manifest, advertisement, ABI, provider requirement, and conformance export contracts.

moveSets.replacementProof: Sai publishes sai.vn plugin manifest and advertisement from the Sai repo or sidecar daemon.
Sai owns VN/Ink ABI describe, validate, project, lower, measure, and apply conformance cases.

forbiddenImports: provider command acceptance or receipt authority
requiredExternalProofs: Sai publishes the sai.vn sidecar ABI without depending on Eve source layout.
Sai owns VN/Ink story state, visual manifest, and story command fixtures.
Providers consume sai.vn through plugin advertisements and ABI operations.
Runtimes declare sai.vn projection support through runtime capability manifests.
